name: OOGVR
summary:
EN - An eye gym in VR, by a lake at dusk. Short exercises inspired by orthoptics:
- Visual check-up: questionnaire and tests, then a profile and a matching plan
- Personalized daily program, adaptive difficulty, progress tracking
- 6 exercises: convergence, fusion, depth, smooth pursuit, saccades, Brock string
- Auto-pause if your head moves: only your eyes work
- No account, no ads, no data collection. 6 languages.
Wellness tool, not a medical device: does not replace an eye care professional. Stop if you
